Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: In Step 11, the Planner incorrectly swapped the release dates and countries for the two films in the "Updated Understanding" section. It stated that "My Wife's Lodger (1952) has an earliest release date in December 1962 (Italy)" and "Tiger of the Seven Seas (1962) has an earliest release date in October 1952 (United Kingdom)." This contradicts the data gathered in the immediately preceding steps (Step 10), which correctly identified that *Tiger of the Seven Seas* was released in Italy in December 1962 and *My Wife's Lodger* was released in the UK in October 1952. Due to this data inversion, the Planner's final conclusion in Step 12 was also incorrect, claiming *Tiger of the Seven Seas* was released earlier when *My Wife's Lodger* was actually released over a decade earlier.
